notes:
This version is required: Meki Cloud sync asks older Macs to update.

New
- Settings › Customise › Tiles chooses what each corner of a photo tile shows, for grids and the filmstrip, with a live preview; it follows the library to your other Macs
- An edit made in Apple Photos comes in as its photo’s final, and the Apple Photos plan lists the edits it will bring and those it can’t
- Remove variants… removes the files of a chosen type from the selected photos, as a task that moves them to Trash
- Archive to is set on the Project tab, and on clients, engagements, Settings and drive cards
- One Mac moves a project to Meki Cloud at a time; a second Mac’s move waits its turn
- Checking the drives before Back up only or Remove Meki Cloud is a task, with its progress on Meki Cloud’s card
- Offloading originals is a task of its own
- Every Info panel row can be removed, Project is no longer a default row, and the exposure readouts sit under the histogram
- Gallery editors show each photo’s download count

Improved
- People and Culling run side by side when the Mac has room, after Auto-Stacking
- Tasks show one line and one bar each, and the title bar shows only the current task; the list orders Auto-Stacking, People, then Culling
- The gallery lightbox pages by finger, zooms smoothly and sharpens in place without a flash
- People review answers leave at once and nothing slides under the pointer
- Gallery cards in Creations open faster in large libraries, and Meki uses less CPU while idle with archived photos
- The Sync popover says what is moving and what it counts

Fixed
- A Meki Cloud copy is released only while a drive copy’s file is there now, and only under its project’s move
- A photo moved to Meki Cloud on another Mac is homed once its copy is known
- The Cloud button no longer says Syncing while nothing can move, and a mode switch shows at once
- Import again retries only the plan’s newest task
- Show in library opens a closed stack to reach the photo
- The storage level sheet’s Change saves the choice it showed
- Smaller fixes across tiles, the title-bar search field and model downloads
